strategy.thesis: One of the largest and most active angel networks in the U.S.; originally Southern California-focused, rebranded from Tech Coast Angels to TCA Venture Group in January 2024 to reflect broader, multi-region investing. Invests in seed through early Series A across all sectors.

application.how_to_apply: Apply for funding via the TCA Venture Group website; companies are screened by regional networks (TCA Los Angeles, TCA Orange County, TCA Inland Empire, plus licensees Pasadena Angels and MEDA Angels).

summary.en: TCA Venture Group (formerly Tech Coast Angels), founded in 1997, is one of the largest U.S. angel networks with 400+ accredited investor members. It has invested over $280 million in 544 companies, with 11 IPOs and 100+ exits, including Procore, Mindbody, Green Dot and Sandpiper Networks.

strategy.thesis: The first organized high-tech angel investment group in the U.S.; members are mostly former and current high-tech executives. Invests pre-seed to Series A, typically $300K-$750K but often leads syndications of $2-3M.

application.how_to_apply: Startups are screened monthly; the Band reviews more than 1,000 deals per year and the full group meets monthly in Silicon Valley.

summary.en: Band of Angels, founded in 1994 and based in Menlo Park, was the first organized high-tech angel investment group in the U.S. Its 150+ angel investors have invested over $400M across 400+ deals, with 17 IPOs and 97 M&A exits, typically writing $300K-$750K checks pre-seed to Series A.
